thesis: PGNY is an extended, overbought stock (RSI 70.5, 7.6% above SMA20) sitting 2% under its 52-week high and almost at the mean analyst target, so consensus upside is nearly gone. The regime is risk-off with VIX at the 99th percentile and QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, and a high-beta mid-cap that has re-rated sharply is vulnerable to a de-grossing wave. The recent support is sell-side target bumps and a Zacks momentum-screen upgrade, which are crowded, lagging signals rather than new fundamentals. Revenue growth of +8.9% YoY is modest for a stock that gapped 14% and has run well above its averages. A repeated failure at 37.21 resistance would leave the stock with little support until the 34.8 stop and then the gap area.
